bodyHtml:
§560:5-307  Confidentiality of records.  The written report of a kokua kanawai and any professional evaluation are confidential and shall be sealed upon filing, but are available to:

     (1)  The court;

     (2)  The respondent without limitation as to use;

     (3)  The petitioner, the kokua kanawai, any nominated guardian, and the petitioner's, nominated guardian's, and respondent's lawyers, for purposes of the proceeding; and

     (4)  Other persons for any purposes that the court may order for good cause. [L 2004, c 161, pt of §1; am L 2008, c 39, §4]

 

Rules of Court

 

  Confidentiality of records, see HPR rule 113.1.
